builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Sett: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A close-range brawler who turns incoming damage into a shield and counterpunch, using pulls and throws to keep enemies within reach. Fix Grit, earned health and center versus edge W. Health and bonus AD interact; real Q attacks are a separate damage route, and lower incoming damage can change Grit acquisition. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Sett: Fix Grit, earned health and center versus edge W. Health and bonus AD interact; real Q attacks are a separate damage route, and lower incoming damage can change Grit acquisition.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Grit. Do not treat mana regeneration as Grit recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Log actual Grit and center/edge W hits.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

The route fails Sett's stated kit question: Fix Grit, earned health and center versus edge W. Health and bonus AD interact; real Q attacks are a separate damage route, and lower incoming damage can change Grit acquisition.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Grit. Do not treat mana regeneration as Grit recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: Only the existing Cassio Q/E or Sett W adapter is numerical. Item/rune effects and attack/utility objectives outside that adapter require manual tests.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Grit-timed Bloodmail
builds.summary: Test missing-health AD during a finite Grit conversion.
builds.goal: Test missing-health AD during a finite Grit conversion.
builds.hypothesis: W caps Grit at half health and scales the conversion with an AD statFormula term. Bloodmail gives bonus-health AD plus missing-health AD; Titanic and Sterak add health while E's two-sided stun can secure W's true-damage center. No full Grit is granted without actual incoming damage. Warmog adds health for the Grit cap; its out-of-combat healing is not active-fight regeneration.
testPlan: Required state: Recorded incoming damage, current health and Grit, with enemies on both sides for E stun.
Compare W center damage at matched earned Grit and differing current health, recording Bloodmail AD before cast.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Grit decays after four seconds or the center misses despite the health investment.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: More health does not automatically provide full Grit or a guaranteed center hit. Titanic and Stridebreaker are competing Cleave purchases.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Titanic Hydra, Sterak's Gage, Warmog's Armor, Spirit Visage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Hullbreaker rewards every fifth real attack against eligible targets, while Trinity rewards spaced spell casts. BotRK and attack speed test the cost of prioritizing punches over a larger W.

Count left/right attacks and Hullbreaker triggers on a turret, then a champion, with Q used between pairs.
